territory.New_Caledonia: Japanese military control under Vichy nominal sovereignty

Japan.rule: Do not decide participation from category labels. Trace location, damage/workup, deck readiness, air group, escort/fuel and task assignment at 1943-11-23.
Japan.secondary_carrier_centered_posture: Bengal hull commitment centered 0; held as two-ocean mobile reserve, then Pacific-priority after US amphibious threat becomes clear. Routine ferry/patrol/training only; pre-GALVANIC rest/maintenance reduces acute fatigue.
Japan.background_trace_rule: Do not count Shoho/Ryuho in the immediate GALVANIC combat wallet until location, air group and deck readiness close. Keep them visible so later Eastern Fleet re-audit does not forget them.
Japan.Junyo_1943_11_05_guard: Historical HALIBUT torpedo damage is not automatically inherited because the historical interception was Ultra-cued while Branch B denies the US that high-grade short-strategic reconstruction. Centered line: no 11/05 torpedo hit; retain a low-probability uncued encounter sensitivity.

United_States.rule: Rebuild late-1943 new-build CV/CVL task groups from actual date-valid readiness, air groups, damage and prior operations; nominal commissioning count is not combat force.

future_boundary: This checkpoint exists to re-adjudicate GALVANIC. Do not use old detailed GALVANIC losses as runtime inputs; they are comparison targets only.
sortie_mobilization_note: 11/23 is the first tactical-resolution checkpoint, not a magic force-materialization date. Charge the staggered US mobilization/departure and Japanese alert/repositioning window before first contact.

weapons.Japanese_air_1943_anchor: Use AIRCRAFT_FIELDING_LEDGER_1943-10-01_v001 + TECH v009 + the GALVANIC sortie-mobilization ledger. By 1943-11-23 Raiden/Kyofu are material; Zuiun is in the first combat-capable-detachment window but local presence requires a deployment trace. D4Y/B6N and all new types use delivery/unit/readiness clocks. No future-type back-port.
weapons.air_weapons: Use date-gated TECH v009 / WEAPON_PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_INDEX capability records and actual unit loadout/readiness. Do not fall back to opening-war air-weapon state for GALVANIC.
weapons.surface: Use SURFACE_COMBATANT_CAPABILITY_LEDGER_1943-10-01_v001 plus actual hull/formation/fuel/readiness. Improved torpedo repeatability, second-salvo integration, fire control and DC are conditional current-branch capabilities, not blanket multipliers.
weapons.radar_ew: Japanese passive ESM can cue bearing history, battle stations, search allocation and torpedo preparation where equipment/training exists; it does not grant automatic weapon-quality tracks or mature US-style CIC performance.

japan_naval_posture.first_line_carriers: Shokaku/Zuikaku/Hiryu/Soryu alive and conserved as a Pacific fleet-in-being; 11/23 actual commitment/readiness is reconstructed from the sortie ledger rather than copied from old GALVANIC.
japan_naval_posture.secondary_carriers: Mandatory trace: Junyo/Hiyo/Ryujo/Zuiho. Bengal hull commitment centered 0; held as two-ocean reserve, then Pacific-priority after US amphibious threat. Routine ferry/patrol/training fatigue only, followed by pre-operation rest/maintenance. Junyo historical 1943-11-05 Ultra-cued torpedo damage is not inherited on the centered Branch-B line.
japan_naval_posture.background_secondary_trace: Shoho/Ryuho remain visible but contribute zero to immediate GALVANIC combat wallet until location, air group and deck readiness are individually closed.
japan_naval_posture.water_air: Marshall/Gilbert search and local defense must include legacy floatplanes/flying boats plus date-valid Kyofu and possible small Zuiun detachments; runway suppression does not automatically erase water-based search/interception.
japan_naval_posture.night_surface: Confidence may be higher for prepared one-pass Long-Lance attack and withdrawal after passive warning/cueing; no blanket confidence bonus for prolonged radar gun action against US SG/CIC.
japan_naval_posture.fatigue_rule: Pay actual routine duty/transit/alert fatigue and rest. Do not charge Bengal campaign exhaustion absent an individual deployment trace.

US_information_state.high_grade_Japanese_crypto: Historical JN-25-like short-strategic plaintext precision remains unavailable in Branch B. Do not reproduce Ultra-cued historical interceptions as automatic events.
US_information_state.residual: Traffic analysis, DF, low-grade/plaintext exploitation, reconnaissance, operational pattern inference and logistics/geography inference remain available and must be adjudicated event by event.
US_information_state.Japanese_COMINT_ESM: Japanese low/mid-grade COMINT and passive ESM can cue search sectors and readiness where local equipment/training exists; no routine SIGABA break and no magic exact-position solution from a bearing alone.
US_information_state.GALVANIC_rule: Old GALVANIC detailed intelligence outcomes are comparison targets only. Reconstruct information age, contact quality and handoff from mobilization onward.

maturation_deltas: Japanese high-grade COMSEC / offensive-COMINT divergence remains active through GALVANIC and changes the probability of historically Ultra-cued submarine/contact events.
By 1943-11-23 Kyofu is a material local-defense system and Zuiun has entered the first combat-capable-detachment window; local allocation remains a separate clock from existence or production.

Japanese seaplane doctrine has matured toward broad search -> suspicious contact -> revisit/re-search -> fast confirmation -> track maintenance -> handoff, conditional on local aircraft, tenders/bases, sea state and communications.
US F6F/new-carrier pressure and late-1943 deck-cycle maturation are active, but Branch carrier losses and altered South-Pacific geography change the actual force and staging sequence.
Secondary Japanese carriers are not presumed Bengal-fatigued: centered Bengal hull allocation is zero; individual Pacific location, air group and readiness must be traced.
Historical 12 Nov Operation-RO stripping of Marshall aircraft is not inherited without a Branch-equivalent transfer, so local air strength must be rebuilt rather than copied from historical GALVANIC.
